text:
Which statement about an atom is correct?
A
An atom has positive charge because there are only positive charges in the nucleus.
B
An atom has negative charge because there are only negative charges in the nucleus.
C
An atom has neutral charge because the positive charge in the nucleus equals the total
negative charge of the electrons.
D
An atom has neutral charge because the negative charge in the nucleus equals the total
positive charge of the electrons.
